text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Japan Cup had finally 
arrived. Gold City asked her Trainer: Why 
did you let me run this far?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Because I knew you wanted to run." When 
the Trainer answered, Gold City laughed in 
exasperation, as if saying he must be out 
of his mind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Because I knew you wanted to run." When 
the Trainer answered, Gold City laughed in 
exasperation, wondering if the Trainer had 
lost their mind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"I'm glad I chose you as my Trainer." 
Declaring that she would run her own way, 
she headed off to the race where 
powerhouse rivals awaited...!
